campaigns.52: Return to The Path to Carcosa

TheZealotsRevenge.name: The Zealot's Revenge
TheZealotsRevenge.text: Have Lita Chantler's reaction ability deal the killing blow to the Ghoul Priest.

IDontTrustHer.name: I Don't Trust Her
IDontTrustHer.text: When given the option to add Lita Chantler to your deck, refuse to do so.

InsuranceDoesntCoverGhouls.name: Insurance Doesn't Cover Ghouls
InsuranceDoesntCoverGhouls.text: Burn your house to the ground in The Gathering.

ButDoIHaveTo.name: …But Do I Have To?
ButDoIHaveTo.text: In The Midnight Masks, have each investigator remain in Your House for the first three rounds.

ConspiracyOfSilence.name: Conspiracy of Silence
ConspiracyOfSilence.text: Find and interrogate all six unique cultists in The Midnight Masks.

TourOfArkham.name: Tour of Arkham
TourOfArkham.text: Trigger each of the "once per game" abilities on all of the locations in play in The Midnight Masks.

DoYouGetItNow.name: Do You Get It Now?
DoYouGetItNow.text: Trigger the Forced ability on Billy Cooper by defeating the Ghoul Priest at his location.

PinchHitter.name: Pinch Hitter
PinchHitter.text: Defeat three Ghoul enemies with a Baseball Bat without it breaking.

EvenDeathMayDie.name: Even Death May Die
EvenDeathMayDie.text: Defeat Umôrdhoth while the Vault of Earthly Demise is attached to it.

BreakTheCircle.name: Break the Circle
BreakTheCircle.text: Complete The Devourer Below without Umôrdhoth spawning.

TheyreJustMisunderstood.name: They're Just Misunderstood
TheyreJustMisunderstood.text: Win the Night of the Zealot campaign without defeating a single unique Cultist enemy.

UmordhothsFavor.name: Umôrdhoth's Favor
UmordhothsFavor.text: Win the Night of the Zealot campaign without defeating a single Ghoul enemy.

ZealotLineInTheSand.name: Line in the Sand
ZealotLineInTheSand.text: Win the Night of the Zealot campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

ArkhamExpertise.name: Arkham Expertise
ArkhamExpertise.text: Win the Night of the Zealot campaign on Expert difficulty.

WhatIsThisStuffAnyway.name: What Is This Stuff, Anyway?
WhatIsThisStuffAnyway.text: Defeat The Experiment using the Alchemical Concoction in Extracurricular Activities.

NoVoidForYou.name: No Void For You
NoVoidForYou.text: Complete The Miskatonic Museum without ever defeating the Hunting Horror.

FirstRuleOfArkham.name: First Rule of Arkham
FirstRuleOfArkham.text: Burn the Necronomicon in The Miskatonic Museum.

AllAboard.name: All Aboard
AllAboard.text: Complete The Essex County Express without letting any Helpless Passengers leave play.

TheGangsAllHere.name: The Gang's All Here
TheGangsAllHere.text: In The Survivors, have the following characters survive The Dunwich Legacy:

NoBroodLeftBehind.name: No Brood Left Behind
NoBroodLeftBehind.text: Have no Broods of Yog-Sothoth escape into the wild in Undimensioned and Unseen.

RemindMeNotToPissHerOff.name: Remind Me Not To Piss Her Off
RemindMeNotToPissHerOff.text: Defeat either version of Seth Bishop while Naomi O'Bannion is under your control.

BeyondWhatVeil.name: Beyond What Veil?
BeyondWhatVeil.text: Take 10 damage from Beyond the Veil without being defeated.

HereWeGoAgain.name: Here We Go Again
HereWeGoAgain.text: Have Dr. Henry Armitage, Dr. Francis Morgan, and Professor Warren Rice in play at the same time.

BirdHunting.name: Bird Hunting
BirdHunting.text: Defeat 3 Whippoorwills in a single turn.

TheyArentGettingAwayWithThis.name: They Aren't Getting Away With This
TheyArentGettingAwayWithThis.text: Win The Dunwich Legacy campaign as "Ashcan" Pete with Duke listed under "Sacrificed to Yog-Sothoth."

TabulaRasa.name: Tabula Rasa
TabulaRasa.text: Win The Dunwich Legacy campaign with no Tablet or Elder Thing tokens in the chaos bag.

DunwichLineInTheSand.name: Line in the Sand
DunwichLineInTheSand.text: Win The Dunwich Legacy campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

DunwichExpertise.name: Dunwich Expertise
DunwichExpertise.text: Win The Dunwich Legacy campaign on Expert difficulty.

FairWarning.name: Fair Warning
FairWarning.text: Defeat the Royal Emissary three times during a single playthrough of Curtain Call.

FirstSteps.name: First Steps
FirstSteps.text: Interview the following VIPs in The Last King:

CrashingTheParty.name: Crashing the Party
CrashingTheParty.text: Defeat the Lunatic version of Dianne Devine in The Last King.

ForPryingEyes.name: For Prying Eyes
ForPryingEyes.text: Add the Hidden Library to the victory display in Echoes of the Past.

TheCuckoosNest.name: The Cuckoo's Nest
TheCuckoosNest.text: Resign with Daniel Chesterfield under an investigator's control in The Unspeakable Oath.

TakeALookAtThis.name: Take a Look at This!
TakeALookAtThis.text: Parley with the Host of Insanity in The Unspeakable Oath.

ThePathOfDeath.name: The Path of Death
ThePathOfDeath.text: Use your Clasp of Black Onyx to find a shortcut in The Pallid Mask.

GuessingGame.name: Guessing Game
GuessingGame.text: Advance to the final agenda of one agenda deck before advancing the first agenda of the other agenda deck in Black Stars Rise.

HasturMadeMeDoIt.name: Hastur Made Me Do It
HasturMadeMeDoIt.text: Defeat Hastur in Dim Carcosa while a Possession treachery is in your hand.

SayMyName.name: Say My Name
SayMyName.text: After you have heeded Daniel's warning, speak the name of HASTUR aloud seven or more times during a single scenario (or its setup).

GetBackHere.name: Get Back Here
GetBackHere.text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign having never ended a scenario with The Man in the Pallid Mask in play.

ThePathIsFalse.name: The Path is False
ThePathIsFalse.text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign with 8 Doubt.

ThePathIsReal.name: The Path is Real
ThePathIsReal.text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign with 8 Conviction.

ThePathIsMine.name: The Path is Mine
ThePathIsMine.text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign with less than 2 Doubt and Conviction in total.

CarcosaLineInTheSand.name: Line in the Sand
CarcosaLineInTheSand.text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

CarcosaExpertise.name: Carcosa Expertise
CarcosaExpertise.text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign on Expert difficulty.

WhyDidItHaveToBeSnakes.name: Why Did It Have to Be Snakes?
WhyDidItHaveToBeSnakes.text: Defeat twenty Serpent enemies across The Forgotten Age campaign.

WatchThemUnravel.name: Watch Them Unravel
WatchThemUnravel.text: Complete all four act decks during a single playthrough of Threads of Fate.

HopeForHumanity.name: Hope for Humanity
HopeForHumanity.text: Restore Ichtaca's faith in humanity in The Boundary Beyond.

Scenario5What.name: Scenario 5-What?
Scenario5What.text: Skip Heart of the Elders, Part 1.

BeyondPerfection.name: Beyond Perfection
BeyondPerfection.text: Complete all eight tasks on act 2 of The City of Archives during a single playthrough.

IRememberEverything.name: I Remember Everything!
IRememberEverything.text: Restore Alejandro's memories in The City of Archives.

Patricide.name: Patricide
Patricide.text: Defeat Yig in The Depths of Yoth.

HesGotAPoint.name: He's Got a Point
HesGotAPoint.text: Side with Alejandro in Shattered Aeons.

ValusiaSoundsGreat.name: Valusia Sounds Great
ValusiaSoundsGreat.text: Side with Ichtaca in Shattered Aeons.

IveBuiltUpAnImmunity.name: I've Built Up An Immunity
IveBuiltUpAnImmunity.text: Win The Forgotten Age campaign without ever becoming poisoned.

WeHaveAnUnderstanding.name: We Have an Understanding
WeHaveAnUnderstanding.text: Win The Forgotten Age campaign without ever dealing any damage to the Harbinger of Valusia.

WhoNeedsAnyOfThisJunk.name: Who Needs Any of This Junk?
WhoNeedsAnyOfThisJunk.text: Win The Forgotten Age campaign without purchasing any supplies.

DontTreadOnMe.name: Don't Tread on Me
DontTreadOnMe.text: Win The Forgotten Age campaign with no tally marks recorded under Yig's Fury in your Campaign Log.

BaneOfYig.name: Bane of Yig
BaneOfYig.text: Win The Forgotten Age campaign with 25 or more tally marks recorded under Yig's Fury in your Campaign Log.

IfICouldTurnBackTime.name: If I Could Turn Back Time
IfICouldTurnBackTime.text: Forge your own path, unlock Scenario IX, and win The Forgotten Age campaign.

YothExpertise.name: Yoth Expertise
YothExpertise.text: Win The Forgotten Age campaign on Expert difficulty.

WhoYouGonnaCall.name: Who You Gonna Call?
WhoYouGonnaCall.text: Defeat 13 Geist or Spectral enemies across the campaign. Enemies who are not discarded or added to the victory display do not count.

SaviorOfHumanity.name: Savior of Humanity
SaviorOfHumanity.text: Rescue every Silver Twilight enemy who appears in At Death's Doorstep.

TenOutOfTenWouldReadAgain.name: 10/10 Would Read Again
TenOutOfTenWouldReadAgain.text: Using The Black Book, take a total of 10 horror with its ability throughout the campaign.

CarlShmarl.name: Carl Shmarl
CarlShmarl.text: Become part of the Silver Twilight Lodge's Inner Circle, then betray them in Union and Disillusion.

TheThreefoldRule.name: The Threefold Rule
TheThreefoldRule.text: Join forces with Erynn and turn on her coven in Union and Disillusion.

NewWorldOrder.name: New World Order
NewWorldOrder.text: Help the Silver Twilight Lodge win The Circle Undone campaign.

ImmortalitySoundsNice.name: Immortality Sounds Nice
ImmortalitySoundsNice.text: Help Anette's Coven win The Circle Undone campaign.

MoreLikeExcursion.name: More Like Excursion
MoreLikeExcursion.text: Complete In the Clutches of Chaos without a single incursion occurring.

CaseClosed.name: Case Closed
CaseClosed.text: Save each of the following characters from a terrible fate:

MusicOfTheOuterGods.name: Music of the Outer Gods
MusicOfTheOuterGods.text: Accept your fate and win The Circle Undone campaign by joining the Pipers of Azathoth.

WeaverOfShadowAndMist.name: Weaver of Shadow and Mist
WeaverOfShadowAndMist.text: Reject your fate and win The Circle Undone campaign by crafting a spell to contain Azathoth.

FinePrint.name: Fine Print
FinePrint.text: Win The Circle Undone campaign by signing your name in The Black Book of Azathoth.

SpeakTheWordsAloud.name: duolA sdroW eht kaepS
SpeakTheWordsAloud.text: Win The Circle Undone campaign by discovering and reversing an ancient incantation.

CircleExpertise.name: Circle Expertise
CircleExpertise.text: Win The Circle Undone campaign on Expert difficulty.

OneFirstLastJob.name: One First Last Job
OneFirstLastJob.text: Complete The Drowned City campaign once on any difficulty.

SeasonTwo.name: Season Two
SeasonTwo.text: Play through the campaign on hard or expert mode using 4 investigators from 4 different previous campaigns. Cannot currently be earned: this requires Epic Campaign Mode, which is not yet implemented.

CliffDiver.name: Cliff Diver
CliffDiver.text: Complete the campaign without ever bringing a diving suit along.

ThisIsACoup.name: This is a Coup
ThisIsACoup.text: Defeat both Naomi O’Bannion and Sadie Sheldon in One Last Job using only the act 3a parley ability.

ThoroughSearch.name: Thorough Search
ThoroughSearch.text: End The Western Wall with every location revealed.

TidalFlipMinigame.name: Tidal Flip Minigame
TidalFlipMinigame.text: Complete The Drowned Quarter with each location revealed and not flooded.

KillTheAdds.name: Kill the Adds
KillTheAdds.text: Defeat Mother in The Apiary using only her Forced effect.

InTheDeepEnd.name: In The Deep End
InTheDeepEnd.text: Escape The Grand Vault with the Tidal Tablet after every location has been fully flooded.

SorryDidntSeeYouThere.name: Sorry, Didn’t See You There
SorryDidntSeeYouThere.text: Beat Court of the Ancients without moving the Great Lift after the Colossal Tyrant spawns.

SkyRider.name: Sky Rider
SkyRider.text: End your turn in open sky at least 5 times during a single game of Obsidian Canyons.

SkipToTheEnd.name: Skip to the End
SkipToTheEnd.text: Defeat Cthulhu in Sepulchre of the Sleeper.

AlienSchoolDropout.name: Alien School Dropout
AlienSchoolDropout.text: Complete the campaign without translating a single alien glyph.

AlienSchoolGraduate.name: Alien School Graduate
AlienSchoolGraduate.text: Translate all 26 alien glyphs during a single playthrough of The Drowned City campaign.

EmptyHanded.name: Empty Handed
EmptyHanded.text: Return from R’lyeh without having collected any Artifact story assets.

WhyWontYouStayDead.name: WHY. WON’T. YOU. STAY. DEAD?!
WhyWontYouStayDead.text: Add The Inescapable to the victory display at least 20 times during a single campaign.

DrownedCityLineInTheSand.name: Line in the Sand
DrownedCityLineInTheSand.text: Win The Drowned City campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

RlyehExpertise.name: R’lyeh Expertise
RlyehExpertise.text: Win The Drowned City campaign on Expert difficulty.

WithYourPowersCombined.name: With Your Powers Combined…
WithYourPowersCombined.text: Finish The Drowned City campaign having earned the following artifacts:

Obligations.name: Obligations
Obligations.text: Finish The Drowned City campaign with the following tasks completed:

DoYouAlwaysFollowOrders.name: Do You Always Follow Orders?
DoYouAlwaysFollowOrders.text: Do not stray from the path in Beyond the Gates of Sleep.

AwwButTheyreSoCute.name: Aww, But They’re So Cute
AwwButTheyreSoCute.text: Do not defeat a single Zoog enemy in Beyond the Gates of Sleep.

LosingMyReligion.name: Losing My Religion
LosingMyReligion.text: In a single playthrough, find and uncover all 10 Signs of the Gods in The Search for Kadath.

FantasyFlightGamesDoesNotCondoneAccompli.name: Fantasy Flight Games (®) Does Not Condone Accomplishing This Achievement
FantasyFlightGamesDoesNotCondoneAccompli.text: Break the law of Ulthar in The Search for Kadath.

TacticalEspionageAction.name: Tactical Espionage Action
TacticalEspionageAction.text: Complete Dark Side of the Moon with each investigator’s alarm level at zero.

MoonLizardsIDontBelieveTheyExist.name: Moon Lizards? I Don’t Believe They Exist
MoonLizardsIDontBelieveTheyExist.text: Defeat the Moon Lizard in Dark Side of the Moon.

BarkhamHorrorEnthusiast.name: Barkham Horror Enthusiast
BarkhamHorrorEnthusiast.text: Defeat 1 or more Cats from Saturn using a fight ability on either a cat ally or a dog ally.

OnlyWayToBeSure.name: Only Way To Be Sure
OnlyWayToBeSure.text: Reduce the High Priest Not to Be Described to 1 remaining health, then shove it down a well anyway in Where the Gods Dwell.

GiveThemSomethingToTalkAbout.name: Give Them Something To Talk About
GiveThemSomethingToTalkAbout.text: In a single round, add every hidden form of Nyarlathotep to the victory display in Where the Gods Dwell.

ThisIsntEvenMyFinalForm.name: This Isn’t Even My Final Form!
ThisIsntEvenMyFinalForm.text: Expose and then defeat Nyarlathotep’s True Shape in Where the Gods Dwell.

DontTellAnyoneBut.name: Don’t Tell Anyone, But…
DontTellAnyoneBut.text: Using the ability on The Great Hall, give 6 different hidden cards to another investigator in Where the Gods Dwell.

DreamQuestLineInTheSand.name: Line in the Sand
DreamQuestLineInTheSand.text: Win The Dream-Quest campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

DreamlandsExpertise.name: Dreamlands Expertise
DreamlandsExpertise.text: Win The Dream-Quest campaign on Expert difficulty.

BewareTheBlackCat.name: Beware The Black Cat
BewareTheBlackCat.text: Complete The Dream-Eaters campaign with okay, fine, have it your way then recorded in your Campaign Log.

ReunitedAndItFeelsSoGood.name: Reunited and it Feels So Good
ReunitedAndItFeelsSoGood.text: Win The Dream-Eaters as an interconnected 8-part campaign, and have both groups reunite during the epilogue.

EveryonesAFeministUntilThereIsASpiderAro.name: Everyone’s a Feminist Until There Is a Spider Around
EveryonesAFeministUntilThereIsASpiderAro.text: Defeat twenty Spider enemies. (Swarm cards do not count.)

TheCarterMethod.name: The Carter Method
TheCarterMethod.text: Let every location get infested, then seal all of them in Waking Nightmare.

TheDoctorIsIn.name: The Doctor is In
TheDoctorIsIn.text: Take Dr. Shivani Maheswaran with you and do not let her take any amount of damage or horror in Waking Nightmare.

DejaVu.name: Déjà Vu
DejaVu.text: Resolve every free triggered ability on every location in A Thousand Shapes of Horror (not counting the Mysterious Stairs during act 2).

TheCasaLomaManeuver.name: The Casa Loma Maneuver
TheCasaLomaManeuver.text: Escape the endless stairs with The Unnamable at the topmost staircase in A Thousand Shapes of Horror.

IRememberThisPlace.name: I Remember This Place
IRememberThisPlace.text: Find a way out of the Underworld in Point of No Return.

BadAdvice.name: Bad Advice
BadAdvice.text: Flip over every location at least once in Point of No Return.

MarchOfTheGhouls.name: March of the Ghouls
MarchOfTheGhouls.text: Have 4 Ghoul enemies attached to Richard Upton Pickman in Point of No Return.

TheIshimuraFlex.name: The Ishimura Flex
TheIshimuraFlex.text: In a single round, defeat all 4 Legs of Atlach-Nacha in Weaver of the Cosmos.

YouSpinMeRightRound.name: You Spin Me Right ’Round
YouSpinMeRightRound.text: Ensure that Atlach-Nacha spins a full 360 degrees in a single phase in Weaver of the Cosmos.

MasterOfUnlocking.name: Master of Unlocking
MasterOfUnlocking.text: Use The Silver Key to cancel a total of at least 10 horror throughout the course of a single scenario.

WebOfDreamsLineInTheSand.name: Line in the Sand
WebOfDreamsLineInTheSand.text: Win The Web of Dreams campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

UnderworldExpertise.name: Underworld Expertise
UnderworldExpertise.text: Win The Web of Dreams campaign on Expert difficulty.

WouldYouJustDieAlready.name: Would You Just Die Already
WouldYouJustDieAlready.text: Defeat The Amalgam 5 or more times in The Pit of Despair.

ElementaryDearDawson.name: Elementary, Dear Dawson
ElementaryDearDawson.text: Guess both the correct Suspect and Hideout in The Vanishing of Elina Harper.

AintNothinGonnaBreakMyStride.name: Ain't Nothin Gonna Break My Stride
AintNothinGonnaBreakMyStride.text: Destroy every barrier in In Too Deep.

SpeedingTicket.name: Speeding Ticket
SpeedingTicket.text: Reach Falcon Point Approach without voluntarily stopping any vehicles, getting out of any vehicles, or entering a copy of Long Way Around in Horror in High Gear.

YoureLockedInHereWithMe.name: You're Locked In Here With Me
YoureLockedInHereWithMe.text: Complete A Light in the Fog without any investigators getting captured.

FishOutOfWater.name: Fish Out of Water
FishOutOfWater.text: Complete Into the Maelstrom with each investigator still wearing their Diving Suits.

DontWakeDaddy.name: Don't Wake Daddy
DontWakeDaddy.text: Complete both The Lair of Dagon and Into the Maelstrom without waking Dagon or Hydra.

FullBuild.name: Full Build
FullBuild.text: Equip the Waveworn Idol, Awakened Mantle and Headdress of Y'ha-nthlei at the same time.

YouWakeUpInARoom.name: “You Wake Up In A Room...”
YouWakeUpInARoom.text: Recover each of the following memories throughout The Innsmouth Conspiracy campaign:

items.ABattleWithAHorrifyingDevil: A battle with a horrifying devil.
items.AnEncounterWithASecretCult: An encounter with a secret cult.

BiggerFishToFry.name: Bigger Fish to Fry
BiggerFishToFry.text: Complete The Innsmouth Conspiracy campaign without defeating a single Deep One enemy.

InnsmouthLineInTheSand.name: Line in the Sand
InnsmouthLineInTheSand.text: Win The Innsmouth Conspiracy campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

InnsmouthExpertise.name: Innsmouth Expertise
InnsmouthExpertise.text: Win The Innsmouth Conspiracy campaign on Expert difficulty.

SafeBet.name: Safe Bet
SafeBet.text: Camp at a location with a shelter value of 8 in Ice and Death, Part I.

LookAtAllThisStuff.name: Look at All This Stuff!
LookAtAllThisStuff.text: Recover all seven supplies in Ice and Death, and carry all of them to The Summit in To the Forbidden Peaks.

InYourHead.name: In Your Head
InYourHead.text: Finish Fatal Mirage with nine story cards in the victory display.

ChaosChaos.name: Chaos Chaos
ChaosChaos.text: Collect and spend a total of ten or more keys in City of the Elder Things.

KnockKnock.name: Knock, Knock
KnockKnock.text: Collect, activate, and place all five seals in The Heart of Madness, Part I.

MadWithPower.name: Mad With Power
MadWithPower.text: Simultaneously exhaust fifteen copies of The Nameless Madness in The Heart of Madness, Part II.

ConstructAdditionalPylons.name: Construct Additional Pylons
ConstructAdditionalPylons.text: Collapse all five Mist-Pylons and escape with your life in The Heart of Madness, Part II.

TheSoundOfMadness.name: The Sound of Madness
TheSoundOfMadness.text: Draw ten copies of “Tekeli-li!” during a single game.

SorryImAllOutOfDogPuns.name: Sorry, I’m All Out of Dog Puns
SorryImAllOutOfDogPuns.text: Have Anyu and four or more other assets with “Dog” in their title in play at the same time.

KindOfAHatOnAHat.name: Kind of a Hat on a Hat
KindOfAHatOnAHat.text: Play a Wooden Sledge from a Backpack, then immediately use its ability to attach a Backpack to it.

ThisWasYourIdea.name: This Was Your Idea
ThisWasYourIdea.text: Use Professor William Dyer’s ability to heal at least 4 horror from Danforth during a single scenario.

NoRespectForTheDead.name: No Respect For the Dead
NoRespectForTheDead.text: Control at least five assets from the Memorials of the Lost encounter set at the same time.

WukWukBoom.name: Wuk Wuk Boom
WukWukBoom.text: Use Dynamite to defeat two Giant Albino Penguins at the same time.

TheColdNeverBotheredMeAnyway.name: The Cold Never Bothered Me Anyway
TheColdNeverBotheredMeAnyway.text: Win the Edge of the Earth campaign with eight Frost tokens in the chaos bag at the end of the campaign.

HellFrozeOver.name: Hell Froze Over
HellFrozeOver.text: Win the Edge of the Earth campaign with zero Frost tokens in the chaos bag at the end of the campaign.

AbandonedAndAlone.name: Abandoned and Alone
AbandonedAndAlone.text: Win the Edge of the Earth campaign without ever bringing a partner asset along with you during a scenario.

FriendsForever.name: Friends Forever
FriendsForever.text: Bring the same partner with you in each scenario, ensure that they have confronted their demons, and win the Edge of the Earth campaign with them still alive.

ThereAndBackAgain.name: There and Back Again
ThereAndBackAgain.text: Win the Edge of the Earth campaign with each of the following survivors:

SnowLineInTheSand.name: Line in the…Snow
SnowLineInTheSand.text: Win the Edge of the Earth campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

AntarcticExpertise.name: Antarctic Expertise
AntarcticExpertise.text: Win the Edge of the Earth campaign on Expert difficulty.

CluedIn.name: Clued In
CluedIn.text: Do not spend or drop a single clue via treachery cards in Riddles and Rain.

TakeThatGhulat.name: Take That, Ghulat
TakeThatGhulat.text: Ensure that not a single civilian is slain in Dead Heat.

WhatsInAName.name: What’s in a Name?
WhatsInAName.text: Tell Amaranth her real name in Dead Heat.

PorqueNoLosDos.name: Porque No Los Dos?
PorqueNoLosDos.text: Defeat both copies of Desi simultaneously in Dancing Mad.

LostAndFound.name: Lost and Found
LostAndFound.text: Take control of the Twisted Antiprism without a single clue on Clues Unveiled in Dealings in the Dark.

ILikeTowerDefenseGames.name: I Like Tower Defense Games
ILikeTowerDefenseGames.text: Defend The Claret Knight without any Key Locuses being destroyed in Dogs of War v. I.

PlayWithYourFood.name: Play With Your Food
PlayWithYourFood.text: Steal The Light of Pharos from either The Claret Knight or The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson while they have exactly 1 health remaining in Dogs of War v. II or v. III.

MoreLikeDestroyedChimera.name: More Like “Destroyed” Chimera
MoreLikeDestroyedChimera.text: Defeat all five forms of the Void Chimera in a single session of On Thin Ice.

WhoWatchesTheWatcher.name: Who Watches the Watcher?
WhoWatchesTheWatcher.text: Unlock a secret final act in Sanguine Shadows.

UnderMyUmbrella.name: Under My Umbrella
UnderMyUmbrella.text: Do not let Tzu San Niang devour a single Geist enemy in Shades of Suffering.

AllHollow.name: All Hollow
AllHollow.text: Learn about a place where Outsiders dwell and travel there to unlock Without a Trace.

RedLooksGoodOnMe.name: Red Looks Good on Me
RedLooksGoodOnMe.text: Join the Red Coterie in Congress of the Keys.

BloodyRedRevolution.name: Bloody Red Revolution
BloodyRedRevolution.text: Overthrow the Red Coterie in Congress of the Keys.

ScarletWithYourPowersCombined.name: With Your Powers Combined…
ScarletWithYourPowersCombined.text: Shift 5 keys in a single turn.

GiftOfGab.name: Gift of Gab
GiftOfGab.text: Ensure that Commissioner Taylor orders you to “talk” 3 times during a single campaign.

ImJustHereForTheLocalCuisine.name: “I’m Just Here for the Local Cuisine”
ImJustHereForTheLocalCuisine.text: In a single campaign, sample cuisine and/or visit bars or cafes from the following locations: Marrakesh, Havana, Buenos Aires, Tokyo, and Kuala Lumpur.

SpeedDemon.name: Speed Demon
SpeedDemon.text: Win The Scarlet Keys campaign with only 17 or fewer time passed.

TrustNobody.name: Trust Nobody
TrustNobody.text: Win The Scarlet Keys campaign with 4 Elder Thing tokens in the chaos bag and without ever removing any Elder Thing tokens.

TrustEverybody.name: Trust Everybody
TrustEverybody.text: Win The Scarlet Keys campaign with 4 Tablet tokens in the chaos bag and without ever removing any Tablet tokens.

HereIsYourBadge.name: Here is Your Badge
HereIsYourBadge.text: Win The Scarlet Keys campaign and earn yourself a permanent position in the Foundation.

KeyToMyHeart.name: Key to My Heart
KeyToMyHeart.text: Collect each of the following keys throughout The Scarlet Keys campaign:

ScarletLineInTheSand.name: Line in the Sand
ScarletLineInTheSand.text: Win The Scarlet Keys campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

GlobalExpertise.name: Global Expertise
GlobalExpertise.text: Win The Scarlet Keys campaign on Expert difficulty.

Aperitif.name: Aperitif
Aperitif.text: Complete The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign once on any difficulty.

Unshattered.name: Unshattered
Unshattered.text: Achieve every ending in this campaign.

items.MarquezSacrificedHerself: Dr. Marquez sacrificed herself for the Vale
items.TheInvestigatorsSacrificedThemselves: The investigators sacrificed themselves for the Vale
items.BarelySurvivedTheFeast: The investigators barely survived the feast
items.BecameTheTrueFeast: The investigators became the true feast

AStrongSilentType.name: A Strong, Silent Type
AStrongSilentType.text: Finish The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign without voluntarily triggering any codex entries.

ColourOutsideTheLines.name: Colour Outside the Lines
ColourOutsideTheLines.text: Skip both The Twisted Hollow and The Longest Night during a single playthrough.

LifeOfTheParty.name: Life of the Party
LifeOfTheParty.text: Complete The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign with each resident at Relationship Level 2 or higher.

DancingQueen.name: Dancing Queen
DancingQueen.text: Share a dance with 4 different residents during The Second Evening prelude.

AudreyIII.name: Audrey III
AudreyIII.text: Complete a scenario engaged with a Poisonblossom having 10 or more overgrowth on it.

HoldOnToYourPotatoes.name: Hold on to your Potatoes!
HoldOnToYourPotatoes.text: Complete Written in Rock with both a resident and the Prismatic Shard asset under your control.

DreamHomeBreakover.name: Dream Home Breakover
DreamHomeBreakover.text: Complete Hemlock House with 10 locations in the victory display.

SettlingTheScore.name: Settling the Score
SettlingTheScore.text: Defeat the Thing in the Depths in The Thing in the Depths.

HereCrabbyCrabby.name: “Here, Crabby Crabby!”
HereCrabbyCrabby.text: Make the Limulus Hybrid flip at least 8 times during The Lost Sister.

ADifferentKindOfStingOps.name: A Different Kind of Sting Ops
ADifferentKindOfStingOps.text: Complete The Silent Heath without spawning the Brood Queen.

WaitTheresNoShroudedShrine.name: Wait, There’s No Shrouded Shrine?
WaitTheresNoShroudedShrine.text: Survive The Twisted Hollow in Standalone Mode until you reach at least Darkness Level 10.

BearNecessities.name: Bear Necessities
BearNecessities.text: Defeat the Ursine Hybrid in The Longest Night using only scenario card effects.

LetsDoTheTimeWarp.name: Let’s Do the Time Warp!
LetsDoTheTimeWarp.text: Complete the Lambs to the Slaughter Resolution in Prelude: The Final Evening.

OblivionShmoblivion.name: Oblivion Shmoblivion
OblivionShmoblivion.text: Win the Fate of the Vale with each Cosmic Emissary enemy in the victory display.

HighDive.name: High Dive
HighDive.text: Sacrifice yourself for the Vale in Fate of the Vale.

BestFriendsForever.name: Best Friends Forever!
BestFriendsForever.text: Reach Relationship Level 6 with the following residents:

KnowYourPlace.name: Know Your Place
KnowYourPlace.text: Win The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign with Mother Rachel at Relationship Level 3 or higher.

HeartOfSteel.name: Heart of Steel
HeartOfSteel.text: Win The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign with Judith Park at Relationship Level 7.

HoldingOutForAHimbo.name: Holding Out for a Himbo
HoldingOutForAHimbo.text: Win The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign with Theo Peters at Relationship Level 7.

CaptivatingScream.name: Captivating Scream
CaptivatingScream.text: Win The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign as Patrice Hathaway.

HemlockLineInTheSand.name: Line in the Sand
HemlockLineInTheSand.text: Win The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

HemlockExpertise.name: Hemlock Expertise
HemlockExpertise.text: Win The Feast of Hemlock Vale campaign on Expert difficulty.
